passages.text: After David had settled into his palace, he said to Nathan the prophet, “Here I am, living in a house of cedar, while the ark of the covenant of the LORD is under a tent.”
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
David lived in a palace.
His palace was made of cedar wood.
Nathan was a prophet.
David spoke to Nathan.
David said, “I live in a house of cedar.
The ark of the covenant of the LORD is not in a house.
The ark is under a tent.”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֕י כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר יָשַׁ֥ב דָּוִ֖יד בְּבֵית֑וֹ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜יד אֶל־ נָתָ֣ן הַנָּבִ֗יא הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֤י יוֹשֵׁב֙ בְּבֵ֣ית הָֽאֲרָזִ֔ים וַאֲר֥וֹן בְּרִית־ יְהוָ֖ה תַּ֥חַת יְרִיעֽוֹת׃

passages.text: And Nathan replied to David, “Do all that is in your heart, for God is with you.”
passages.sermon:
Nathan was a prophet.
David was the king of Israel.
Nathan spoke to David.
Nathan said, "Do everything that is in your heart."
Nathan said, "God is with you."
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר נָתָן֙ אֶל־ דָּוִ֔יד כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּֽלְבָבְךָ֖ עֲשֵׂ֑ה כִּ֥י הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים עִמָּֽךְ׃ס

passages.text: But that night the word of God came to Nathan, saying, “Go and tell My servant David that this is what the LORD says: You are not the one to build Me a house in which to dwell.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Nathan during the night.
God gave Nathan a message.
God told Nathan to speak to David.
David was God’s servant.
God said, “This is what the LORD says.”
God said to David, “You will not build a house for Me to live in.”
passages.original: וַֽיְהִ֖י בַּלַּ֣יְלָה הַה֑וּא וַיְהִי֙ דְּבַר־ אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֶל־ נָתָ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃ לֵ֤ךְ וְאָמַרְתָּ֙ אֶל־ דָּוִ֣יד עַבְדִּ֔י כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה לֹ֥א אַתָּ֛ה תִּבְנֶה־ לִּ֥י הַבַּ֖יִת לָשָֽׁבֶת׃

passages.text: For I have not dwelt in a house from the day I brought Israel up out of Egypt until this day, but I have moved from tent to tent and dwelling to dwelling.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Nathan the prophet.
God told Nathan to speak to David, king of Israel.
God said, “I did not live in a house.
I brought the people of Israel out of Egypt.
From that day until now, I have not lived in a house.
I moved from one tent to another.
I moved from one dwelling place to another.”
passages.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יָשַׁ֙בְתִּי֙ בְּבַ֔יִת מִן־ הַיּ֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֶעֱלֵ֙יתִי֙ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַ֖ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וָֽאֶהְיֶ֛ה מֵאֹ֥הֶל אֶל־ אֹ֖הֶל וּמִמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃

passages.text: In all My journeys with all the Israelites, have I ever asked any of the leaders I appointed to shepherd My people, ‘Why haven’t you built Me a house of cedar?’
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Nathan at night.
God told Nathan to speak to David.
God is the LORD.
God led the Israelites in all their journeys.
God appointed leaders over Israel.
God commanded these leaders to care for His people.
God never asked any leader this question.
God never said, “Why have you not built Me a house of cedar?”
passages.original: בְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶֽׁר־ הִתְהַלַּכְתִּי֮ בְּכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ הֲדָבָ֣ר דִּבַּ֗רְתִּי אֶת־ אַחַד֙ שֹׁפְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֛יתִי לִרְע֥וֹת אֶת־ עַמִּ֖י לֵאמֹ֑ר לָ֛מָּה לֹא־ בְנִיתֶ֥ם לִ֖י בֵּ֥ית אֲרָזִֽים׃

passages.text: Now then, you are to tell My servant David that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: I took you from the pasture, from following the flock, to be the ruler over My people Israel.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts speaks to David.
David is God's servant.
God took David from the pasture.
David was following the flock.
God made David ruler over His people Israel.
passages.original: וְ֠עַתָּה כֹּֽה־ תֹאמַ֞ר לְעַבְדִּ֣י לְדָוִ֗ידס כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת אֲנִ֤י לְקַחְתִּ֙יךָ֙ מִן־ הַנָּוֶ֔ה מִֽן־ אַחֲרֵ֖י הַצֹּ֑אן לִהְי֣וֹת נָגִ֔יד עַ֖ל עַמִּ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and I have cut off all your enemies from before you. Now I will make for you a name like the greatest in the land.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to David.
God is the LORD of Hosts.
God said, "I have been with you everywhere you have gone."
God said, "I have destroyed all your enemies who stood before you."
God said, "I will make your name great."
God said, "Your name will be like the names of the greatest people on earth."
passages.original: וָֽאֶהְיֶ֣ה עִמְּךָ֗ בְּכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָלַ֔כְתָּ וָאַכְרִ֥ית אֶת־ כָּל־ אוֹיְבֶ֖יךָ מִפָּנֶ֑יךָ וְעָשִׂ֤יתִֽי לְךָ֙ שֵׁ֔ם כְּשֵׁ֥ם הַגְּדוֹלִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: And I will provide a place for My people Israel and will plant them so that they may dwell in a place of their own and be disturbed no more. No longer will the sons of wickedness oppress them as they did at the beginning and have done since the day I appointed judges over My people Israel. And I will subdue all your enemies. Moreover, I declare to you that the LORD will build a house for you.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to David.
God is the LORD of Hosts.
God says, “I will give My people Israel a place.
I will plant them there.
They will live in their own land.
They will not be disturbed anymore.
Evil people will not oppress them again.
This will not happen as it did before.
This will not happen as it did when I first appointed judges over Israel.
I will defeat all your enemies.
I tell you this now.
The LORD will build a house for you.”
passages.original: וְשַׂמְתִּ֣י מָ֠קוֹם לְעַמִּ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל וּנְטַעְתִּ֙יהוּ֙ וְשָׁכַ֣ן תַּחְתָּ֔יו וְלֹ֥א יִרְגַּ֖ז ע֑וֹד וְלֹא־ יוֹסִ֤יפוּ בְנֵי־ עַוְלָה֙ לְבַלֹּת֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר בָּרִאשׁוֹנָֽה׃ וּלְמִיָּמִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוִּ֤יתִי שֹֽׁפְטִים֙ עַל־ עַמִּ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְהִכְנַ֖עְתִּי אֶת־ כָּל־ אוֹיְבֶ֑יךָ וָאַגִּ֣ד לָ֔ךְ וּבַ֖יִת יִֽבְנֶה־ לְּךָ֥ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: And when your days are fulfilled and you go to be with your fathers, I will raise up your descendant after you, one of your own sons, and I will establish his kingdom.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to King David.
God promised David a future for his family.
God said, “When your life is complete, you will join your ancestors.”
God said, “After you die, I will raise up your descendant.”
This descendant will come from your own sons.
I will make his kingdom strong.
I will establish his rule.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֗ה כִּֽי־ מָלְא֤וּ יָמֶ֙יךָ֙ לָלֶ֣כֶת עִם־ אֲבֹתֶ֔יךָ וַהֲקִֽימוֹתִ֤י אֶֽת־ זַרְעֲךָ֙ אַחֲרֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִהְיֶ֖ה מִבָּנֶ֑יךָ וַהֲכִינוֹתִ֖י אֶת־ מַלְכוּתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: He will build a house for Me, and I will establish his throne forever.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to David about his son.
David’s son will build a house for God.
God will make the throne of David’s son strong.
God will keep his throne forever.
passages.original: ה֥וּא יִבְנֶה־ לִּ֖י בָּ֑יִת וְכֹנַנְתִּ֥י אֶת־ כִּסְא֖וֹ עַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃

passages.text: I will be his Father, and he will be My son. And I will never remove My loving devotion from him as I removed it from your predecessor.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to David about David’s future son.
God said, “I will be a Father to him.
He will be a son to Me.
I will always show him My faithful love.
I will not take away My love from him.
I took away My love from the king who ruled before you.
But I will not do that to your son.”
passages.original: אֲנִי֙ אֶֽהְיֶה־ לּ֣וֹ לְאָ֔ב וְה֖וּא יִֽהְיֶה־ לִּ֣י לְבֵ֑ן וְחַסְדִּי֙ לֹא־ אָסִ֣יר מֵֽעִמּ֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר הֲסִיר֔וֹתִי מֵאֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיָ֖ה לְפָנֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: But I will set him over My house and My kingdom forever, and his throne will be established forever.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke about David’s descendant.
God said, “I will place him over My house.
I will give him authority in My kingdom forever.
His throne will stand firm forever.”
passages.original: וְהַֽעֲמַדְתִּ֛יהוּ בְּבֵיתִ֥י וּבְמַלְכוּתִ֖י עַד־ הָעוֹלָ֑ם וְכִסְא֕וֹ יִהְיֶ֥ה נָכ֖וֹן עַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃

passages.text: So Nathan relayed to David all the words of this entire vision.
passages.sermon:
Nathan was a prophet.
Nathan received a vision from God.
The vision contained many words and instructions.
Nathan spoke all these words to David.
Nathan told David everything from the vision.
passages.original: כְּכֹל֙ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה וּכְכֹ֖ל הֶחָז֣וֹן הַזֶּ֑ה כֵּ֛ן דִּבֶּ֥ר נָתָ֖ן אֶל־ דָּוִֽיד׃פ

passages.text: Then King David went in, sat before the LORD, and said, “Who am I, O LORD God, and what is my house, that You have brought me this far?
passages.sermon:
King David was the ruler of Israel.
David entered the presence of the LORD.
David sat before the LORD.
David spoke to the LORD God.
David said, “Who am I, O LORD God?”
David asked, “What is my house?”
David said, “You have brought me this far.”
passages.original: וַיָּבֹא֙ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֔יד וַיֵּ֖שֶׁב לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיֹּ֗אמֶר מִֽי־ אֲנִ֞י יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהִים֙ וּמִ֣י בֵיתִ֔י כִּ֥י הֲבִיאֹתַ֖נִי עַד־ הֲלֹֽם׃

passages.text: And as if this was a small thing in Your eyes, O God, You have spoken about the future of the house of Your servant and have regarded me as a man of great distinction, O LORD God.
passages.sermon:
God is the one David addresses.
God does not see His blessings as a small thing.
God spoke about the future of David’s house.
God called David His servant.
God looked at David as a man of great distinction.
The LORD God gave David this honor.
passages.original: וַתִּקְטַ֨ן זֹ֤את בְּעֵינֶ֙יךָ֙ אֱלֹהִ֔ים וַתְּדַבֵּ֥ר עַל־ בֵּֽית־ עַבְדְּךָ֖ לְמֵרָח֑וֹק וּרְאִיתַ֗נִי כְּת֧וֹר הָאָדָ֛ם הַֽמַּעֲלָ֖ה יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: What more can David say to You for so honoring Your servant? For You know Your servant, O LORD. For the sake of Your servant and according to Your own heart, You have accomplished this great thing and revealed all Your greatness.
passages.sermon:
King David spoke to the LORD.
David asked, "What more can I say to You?"
You have given great honor to Your servant.
You know Your servant, O LORD.
You did this for the sake of Your servant.
You acted according to Your own heart.
You accomplished this great thing.
You revealed all Your greatness.
passages.original: מַה־ יּוֹסִ֨יף ע֥וֹד דָּוִ֛יד אֵלֶ֖יךָ לְכָב֣וֹד אֶת־ עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ וְאַתָּ֖ה אֶֽת־ עַבְדְּךָ֥ יָדָֽעְתָּ׃ יְהוָ֕ה בַּעֲב֤וּר עַבְדְּךָ֙ וּֽכְלִבְּךָ֔ עָשִׂ֕יתָ אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַגְּדוּלָּ֖ה הַזֹּ֑את לְהֹדִ֖יעַ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַגְּדֻלּֽוֹת׃

passages.text: O LORD, there is none like You, and there is no God but You, according to everything we have heard with our own ears.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is unique.
No one is like the LORD.
No other god exists except the LORD.
We have heard this with our own ears.
Everything we know confirms this truth.
passages.original: יְהוָה֙ אֵ֣ין כָּמ֔וֹךָ וְאֵ֥ין אֱלֹהִ֖ים זוּלָתֶ֑ךָ בְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁמַ֖עְנוּ בְּאָזְנֵֽינוּ׃

passages.text: And who is like Your people Israel—the one nation on earth whom God went out to redeem as a people for Himself? You made a name for Yourself through great and awesome wonders by driving out nations from before Your people, whom You redeemed from Egypt.
passages.sermon:
God chose the people of Israel.
Israel is one nation on earth.
God went out to redeem Israel for Himself.
God made Israel His own people.
God made a great name for Himself.
God did great and awesome wonders.
God drove out nations before His people.
God redeemed His people from Egypt.
passages.original: וּמִי֙ כְּעַמְּךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל גּ֥וֹי אֶחָ֖ד בָּאָ֑רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֩ הָלַ֨ךְ הָאֱלֹהִ֜ים לִפְדּ֧וֹת ל֣וֹ עָ֗ם לָשׂ֤וּם לְךָ֙ שֵׁ֚ם גְּדֻלּ֣וֹת וְנֹרָא֔וֹת לְגָרֵ֗שׁ מִפְּנֵ֧י עַמְּךָ֛ אֲשֶׁר־ פָּדִ֥יתָ מִמִּצְרַ֖יִם גּוֹיִֽם׃

passages.text: For You have made Your people Israel Your very own forever, and You, O LORD, have become their God.
passages.sermon:
God chose the people of Israel.
God made Israel His own people.
God did this forever.
The LORD became the God of Israel.
passages.original: וַ֠תִּתֵּן אֶת־ עַמְּךָ֨ יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל׀ לְךָ֛ לְעָ֖ם עַד־ עוֹלָ֑ם וְאַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה הָיִ֥יתָ לָהֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: And now, O LORD, let the word You have spoken concerning Your servant and his house be established forever. Do as You have promised, so that Your name will be established and magnified forever when it is said, ‘The LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, is God over Israel.’ And may the house of Your servant David be established before You.
passages.sermon:
O LORD, You are God.
You spoke a word about Your servant David and his house.
Let this word stand firm forever.
Do what You have promised.
Let Your name be established forever.
Let people say, “The LORD of Hosts is the God of Israel.”
Let people know, “The LORD is God over Israel.”
Let the house of Your servant David stand firm before You.
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה הַדָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבַּ֤רְתָּ עַֽל־ עַבְדְּךָ֙ וְעַל־ בֵּית֔וֹ יֵאָמֵ֖ן עַד־ עוֹלָ֑ם וַעֲשֵׂ֖ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּֽרְתָּ׃ וְ֠יֵֽאָמֵן וְיִגְדַּ֨ל שִׁמְךָ֤ עַד־ עוֹלָם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֱלֹהִ֖ים לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּבֵית־ דָּוִ֥יד עַבְדְּךָ֖ נָכ֥וֹן לְפָנֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: For You, my God, have revealed to Your servant that You will build a house for him. Therefore Your servant has found the courage to pray before You.
passages.sermon:
God is speaking to David.
God is David’s God.
God revealed something to David.
God told David He would build a house for him.
Because of this, David found courage.
David prayed before God.
passages.original: כִּ֣י׀ אַתָּ֣ה אֱלֹהַ֗י גָּלִ֙יתָ֙ אֶת־ אֹ֣זֶן עַבְדְּךָ֔ לִבְנ֥וֹת ל֖וֹ בָּ֑יִת עַל־ כֵּן֙ מָצָ֣א עַבְדְּךָ֔ לְהִתְפַּלֵּ֖ל לְפָנֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: And now, O LORD, You are God! And You have promised this goodness to Your servant.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD spoke to David.
The LORD promised good things to David.
The LORD promised this goodness to His servant.
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה אַתָּה־ ה֖וּא הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וַתְּדַבֵּר֙ עַֽל־ עַבְדְּךָ֔ הַטּוֹבָ֖ה הַזֹּֽאת׃

passages.text: So now You have been pleased to bless the house of Your servant, that it may continue forever before You. For You, O LORD, have blessed it, and it will be blessed forever.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD has chosen to bless the house of His servant David.
God wants David’s house to stand forever before Him.
The LORD has already blessed David’s house.
Because of God’s blessing, David’s house will remain blessed forever.
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה הוֹאַ֙לְתָּ֙ לְבָרֵךְ֙ אֶת־ בֵּ֣ית עַבְדְּךָ֔ לִהְי֥וֹת לְעוֹלָ֖ם לְפָנֶ֑יךָ כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ בֵּרַ֔כְתָּ וּמְבֹרָ֖ךְ לְעוֹלָֽם׃פ
